sloka: इमे च विपुलास्सालास्सप्त शाखावलम्बिनः ।यत्रैकं घटते वाली निष्पत्रयितुमोजसा ॥४-११-६७॥।।
transliteration: ime ca vipulāssālāssapta śākhāvalambinaḥ ।yatraikaṁ ghaṭate vālī niṣpatrayitumojasā ॥4-11-67॥।।

translations.english: 'Look at these seven sturdy Sala trees with branches of one overlapping the other. Vali was able to remove all the leaves of one Sala tree with just one arrow.
